create_connection_to_dm_env_rpc_server: create a Connection instance with a gRPC channel to interact with a dm_env_rpc server
send_request_to_dm_env_rpc_server: send a dm_env_rpc Request message to the server and receive the corresponding Response
create_secure_channel_and_connect: create a secure gRPC channel with unbounded message lengths and connect to a dm_env_rpc server
close_connection_to_dm_env_rpc_server: close the Connection and its underlying gRPC stream when no longer needed
use_connection_as_context_manager: use Connection as a context manager to automatically close the connection on exit
